title: skills: objectstack-ui teaches only the named report navigation item, not the report-index form #27566 adds
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 from the triage contract review of PR #27566 (#27525, comment 6498961917), a governed follow-up. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## Observed

PR #27566 lets a `type: 'report'` navigation item omit `reportName`: absent means the app's report index (`<app>/reports`), and the console no longer injects an "All reports" row on its own (an app shows the index only where its navigation declares it). The governed skills still teach only the one-report form: `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:171` lists `report` with `reportName` as its key, and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md:38` shows only a named report. An AI author following them never learns the index item, and after #27566 an app without one has no report index entry.

## Wanted

After PR #27566 merges: both skills pages teach the index form (`{ type: 'report' }` with no `reportName` = the report index) beside the named form, within each file's token ratchet.

## Dedupe words

skills navigation report reportName index all reports injected row objectstack-ui
